sections.heading: History
sections.text:
White, along with Mallory, attacked Dante Vale's team from a clifftop when the group was swimming to the coast of England. After White's Feyone and Mallory's Icarus were defeated the team, the led Dante, Lok and Zhalia into a trap. During the intense battle, White used Newlife to revive his Palamedes Titan. The pair eventually overpowered the team but were called of by Nimue. [Cave of the Casterwills]

White was present at the Casterwill meeting at the Fortress of Iron Will. [Sophie on Trial] He and Mallory held Santiago back from going to find Sophie whilst on the Trial of Courage. He later fought against the Blood Spiral along with the rest of the Casterwill family in defending the Fortress of Iron Will. He was much dismayed at the death of Nimue. [The Spiral War]

In the final battle against the Betrayer and his Blood Spirals, White and Mallory were knocked out by Shauna whilst protecting Vivian Casterwill but she was stopped from finishing them off by Vivian, who invoked Mythras. [Lok and the Betrayer] Following the defeat of the Betrayer, both recovered after the battle. [Dante's Return]

White is one of the ancient guardians of Nimue Casterwill and works alongside Mallory, guarding the secrets of the Crystal Caves on the coast of England and protecting the current Lady of the Lake, Vivian Casterwill.

History

White, along with Mallory, attacked Dante Vale's team from a clifftop when the group was swimming to the coast of England. After White's Feyone and Mallory's Icarus were defeated the team, the led Dante, Lok and Zhalia into a trap. During the intense battle, White used Newlife to revive his Palamedes Titan. The pair eventually overpowered the team but were called of by Nimue. [Cave of the Casterwills]

White was present at the Casterwill meeting at the Fortress of Iron Will. [Sophie on Trial] He and Mallory held Santiago back from going to find Sophie whilst on the Trial of Courage. He later fought against the Blood Spiral along with the rest of the Casterwill family in defending the Fortress of Iron Will. He was much dismayed at the death of Nimue. [The Spiral War]

In the final battle against the Betrayer and his Blood Spirals, White and Mallory were knocked out by Shauna whilst protecting Vivian Casterwill but she was stopped from finishing them off by Vivian, who invoked Mythras. [Lok and the Betrayer] Following the defeat of the Betrayer, both recovered after the battle. [Dante's Return]

Abilities

White and Mallory make a formidable team, defeating any unsuspecting trespassers who venture into the Crystal Caves. Like his partner Casterwill guardian, White is skilled at melee combat and uses a sword. He is also able to use powerful Casterwill magic.

Palamedes — White's signature warrior fights with an axe and is the brother of Mallory's Titan, Pellinore.

'''White''' is one of the ancient guardians of [[Nimue Casterwill]] and works alongside [[Mallory]], guarding the secrets of the [[Crystal Caves]] on the coast of [[England]] and protecting the current Lady of the Lake, [[Vivian Casterwill]].

==History==
White, along with [[Mallory]], attacked [[Dante Vale|Dante Vale's]] team from a clifftop when the group was swimming to the coast of [[England]]. After White's [[Feyone]] and [[Mallory]]'s [[Icarus]] were defeated the team, the led Dante, [[Lok]] and [[Zhalia]] into a trap. During the intense battle, White used [[Newlife]] to revive his [[Palamedes]] Titan. The pair eventually overpowered the team but were called of by [[Nimue]]. {{source|Cave of the Casterwills}} 

White was present at the Casterwill meeting at the [[Fortress of Iron Will]]. {{source|Sophie on Trial}} He and Mallory held [[Santiago]] back from going to find [[Sophie]] whilst on the Trial of Courage. He later fought against the [[Blood Spiral]] along with the rest of the [[Casterwill family]] in defending the [[Fortress of Iron Will]]. He was much dismayed at the death of Nimue. {{source|The Spiral War}} 

In the final battle against [[the Betrayer]] and his Blood Spirals, White and Mallory were knocked out by [[Shauna]] whilst protecting [[Vivian Casterwill]] but she was stopped from finishing them off by Vivian, who invoked [[Mythras]]. {{source|Lok and the Betrayer}} Following the defeat of [[the Betrayer]], both recovered after the battle. {{source|Dante's Return}}

==Abilities==
White and [[Mallory]] make a formidable team, defeating any unsuspecting trespassers who venture into the [[Crystal Caves]]. Like his partner Casterwill guardian, White is skilled at melee combat and uses a sword. He is also able to use powerful [[:Category:Casterwill family magic|Casterwill magic]].
